tickets.subject: Password reset email never arrives
tickets.body: I have requested a reset three times and nothing shows up, not even in spam.

tickets.subject: Order stuck in Processing for four days
tickets.body: Order B-11203 has been in Processing since Monday with no tracking number.

tickets.subject: Charged twice for the same subscription
tickets.body: My card statement shows two charges on the same day for the March plan.

tickets.subject: API key stopped working after rotation
tickets.body: After rotating the key in Settings every request returns 401.

tickets.subject: Cannot add a second user to the account
tickets.body: The Invite button on the Users page does nothing when clicked.

tickets.subject: Tracking page shows the wrong carrier
tickets.body: The tracking link opens DHL but the parcel went with UPS.

tickets.subject: Invoice export to CSV drops the VAT column
tickets.body: Since the February update the invoice export leaves the VAT column empty for every line. We use the export for our monthly VAT return.

tickets.subject: Discount code not applied at checkout
tickets.body: SPRING10 is accepted but the total does not change.

tickets.subject: Zapier integration drops attachments
tickets.body: Files attached to orders are missing when the Zap fires.

tickets.subject: Invoice export fails with error 500
tickets.body: Clicking Export on the invoices page returns a server error. Started yesterday afternoon.

tickets.subject: Dashboard numbers do not add up
tickets.body: The weekly revenue tile shows a figure that is higher than the sum of the daily tiles.

tickets.subject: Receipt PDF has the wrong date format
tickets.body: Receipts show the date as 02/03/2026 which our accountant reads as 3 February.

tickets.subject: Export of invoices times out for January
tickets.body: Running the invoice export for January 2026 spins for a minute and then shows a timeout page. December exports fine.

tickets.subject: Return label link expired
tickets.body: The return label emailed to our customer expired before they could print it.

tickets.subject: Need to change the account owner
tickets.body: Our previous admin has left; please move ownership to me.

tickets.subject: Shipping label export prints blank pages
tickets.body: The label export for last week's orders produces blank pages on our Zebra printer. Single labels print fine.

tickets.subject: Export of customer list is truncated
tickets.body: The customer export stops at 5,000 rows but we have 7,200 customers.

tickets.subject: Session logs out every ten minutes
tickets.body: Since last week I am signed out roughly every ten minutes while working.

tickets.subject: Pallet shipment quoted at parcel rate
tickets.body: The quote for 6 pallets came back at a parcel price and failed at booking.

tickets.subject: Refund not received after 14 days
tickets.body: The refund for invoice INV-20419 was confirmed on 10 February but has not arrived.

tickets.subject: Invoice export missing credit notes
tickets.body: The invoice export only includes positive invoices. Credit notes issued in the same period are missing, so the totals do not reconcile.

tickets.subject: Slack notifications arrive twice
tickets.body: Every order notification posts twice to our channel.

tickets.subject: Invoice shows a line item we did not order
tickets.body: Invoice INV-20733 lists 2 units of the Pro add-on, which we never added.

tickets.subject: Search ignores part numbers
tickets.body: Searching for KX-440 returns nothing although the part exists.

tickets.subject: Change the billing address on our invoices
tickets.body: We moved offices on 1 February. Invoices still show the old address; please update it to 14 Harbour Row, Leith.

tickets.subject: Monthly report email is blank
tickets.body: The report email arrives with a subject line but no body.

tickets.subject: Address validation rejects valid postcode
tickets.body: The checkout refuses EH6 6JJ, which is our real postcode.

tickets.subject: Upgrade to annual plan not reflected
tickets.body: I upgraded on 1 March but the plan page still says Monthly.

tickets.subject: Webhook signature mismatch
tickets.body: Our endpoint rejects every webhook because the signature header does not verify.

tickets.subject: Two-factor codes arrive late
tickets.body: SMS codes for sign-in take five to ten minutes to arrive, by which time they have expired.

tickets.subject: Need an invoice for last year's payments
tickets.body: Please send a consolidated invoice for all 2025 payments for our audit.

tickets.subject: Cannot download the data export
tickets.body: The link on the Export page opens a blank tab.

tickets.subject: Delivery left with neighbour without consent
tickets.body: The courier left the parcel with a neighbour although we opted out.

tickets.subject: Cannot export invoices as PDF bundle
tickets.body: Choosing PDF bundle in the invoice export dialog downloads a zero-byte file. CSV has the VAT problem reported separately, so right now no export works for us.

tickets.subject: Login works on desktop but not on the phone
tickets.body: The mobile sign-in page loops back to itself after entering the code.

tickets.subject: Sales tax applied to an exempt order
tickets.body: Order B-11490 should be tax exempt but tax was added.

tickets.subject: Invoice export shows the wrong company name
tickets.body: Our invoice export header says Northwind Health Ltd instead of Northwind Health Group. The invoices themselves are right.

tickets.subject: Inventory sync stops at midnight
tickets.body: The nightly inventory sync from our ERP stops partway every night.

tickets.subject: Statement export has duplicate rows
tickets.body: The account statement export lists some payments twice.

tickets.subject: Custom field missing from the order form
tickets.body: The PO number field we added is not shown on new orders.

tickets.subject: Shipment split without notice
tickets.body: Order B-11388 arrived in two boxes on different days without any email.

tickets.subject: Wrong currency on March invoices
tickets.body: The first three invoices in March are in USD although our account is set to EUR.

tickets.subject: Cannot remove an old payment card
tickets.body: The expired card cannot be deleted from Billing settings.

tickets.subject: OAuth consent screen shows the wrong app name
tickets.body: Our integration shows up as Test App on the consent screen.

tickets.subject: Priority support line not answering
tickets.body: We are on the Plus plan but the priority number goes to voicemail.

tickets.subject: Invoice emails go to the wrong contact
tickets.body: Invoices are sent to our former finance contact despite the change.

tickets.subject: Picking list prints in the wrong order
tickets.body: The picking list sorts by product name instead of bin location.

tickets.subject: Exported invoice totals do not match the statement
tickets.body: The grand total in the invoice export is 1,840.00 lower than the account statement for the same range. Looks like the export skips invoices paid by credit.

tickets.subject: Two accounts with the same email
tickets.body: I seem to have two accounts and can only log in to the older one.

tickets.subject: Webhook payload missing customer notes
tickets.body: The order webhook no longer includes the notes field.

tickets.subject: Late fee applied in error
tickets.body: A late fee was added although the invoice was paid on the due date.

tickets.subject: Export to QuickBooks fails on refunds
tickets.body: The QuickBooks export errors out whenever the period includes a refund.

tickets.subject: Order confirmation email in the wrong language
tickets.body: Our customers in Lyon receive confirmations in German.

tickets.subject: Returns portal shows another customer's order
tickets.body: Entering our order number shows a different customer's details.

tickets.subject: Webhook retries stop after two attempts
tickets.body: Our order webhook endpoint was down for twenty minutes and the retries stopped after the second attempt instead of backing off.

tickets.subject: Need VAT number on invoices
tickets.body: Our VAT number is missing from all invoices this year.

tickets.subject: Pagination skips a page in the orders list
tickets.body: Page 3 of the orders list repeats page 2.

tickets.subject: Can't change the time zone
tickets.body: The time zone dropdown in Settings is empty.

tickets.subject: SFTP delivery of reports stopped
tickets.body: The nightly SFTP push of our reports has not run since 20 February.

tickets.subject: Shipping cost shows zero for international
tickets.body: International orders show 0.00 shipping at checkout.

comments.author: Priya Raman
comments.body: Fixed in the 29 January deploy; closing.

comments.author: Daniel Okafor
comments.body: Reproduced with the February build. Passing to engineering.

comments.body: Address change needs a signed form; sent the template.

comments.body: Asked the customer for the statement export to compare.
